Title: Verify download of a missing/deleted file
Test Steps: 1. Attempt to download a file that has been removed from the server.
Expected Result (ER): An error message is displayed (e.g., "File not found") rather than a corrupted file.

Title: Verify download with no internet connectivity
Expected Result (ER): The browser handles the interruption gracefully (pauses or gives a network error) without crashing.

Title: Verify download for unauthorized user
Test Steps:
1. Log in as a user without download permissions.
2. Attempt to click the download link.
Expected Result (ER): Access denied error or button is disabled

Title: Verify successful download of a PDF document
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the documents page.
2. Click on the "Download" button for a PDF file.
3. Verify file prompt or auto-download.
Expected Result (ER): The PDF file downloads successfully, is not corrupted, and content matches the server version.

Title: Verify download functionality for different file types
Test Steps:
1. Click download for .zip, .csv, and .docx files respectively.
2. Click download.
Expected Result (ER): All file types download with correct extensions and file sizes.

Title: Verify download with special characters in file name
Expected Result (ER): File downloads without errors, and the filename is preserved.

Title: Verify download for large files
Test Steps: 1. Click download for a large file (>100MB).
Expected Result (ER): The browser does not time out; a progress indicator appears.

Title: Verify multiple simultaneous downloads
Test Steps: 1. Click download on three different files at the same time.
Expected Result (ER): All files download successfully without corrupting each other.
